    [Id] int NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT [PK_QuarryNotes] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])

CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON [QuarryNotes]([Text] LANGUAGE [English]) KEY INDEX [PK_QuarryNotes] ON [QuarryWords];

DECLARE @p4 int = 3;
DECLARE @needle sql_variant = Microsoft.Data.SqlTypes.SqlVector`1[System.Single];

FROM [QuarryNotes] AS [q]
LEFT JOIN CONTAINSTABLE([QuarryNotes], [Text], @p) AS [c] ON [q].[Id] = [c].[KEY]
